simulation_specs.description: Bet every held-out trigger game favorite at best pre-game price.
Bet if N03 final-win probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.00.
Bet if N03 final-win probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.05.
Bet if N03 final-win probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.10.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.00; heuristic only.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.05; heuristic only.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - raw market break-even probability >= 0.10; heuristic only.
Bet if deepest trigger is D=10 or higher.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - Stern-Winston CFB state price >= 0.03; heuristic only.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - Stern-Winston CFB state price >= 0.05; heuristic only.
Bet if N06 deficit-erased probability - Stern-Winston CFB state price >= 0.10; heuristic only.
Bet if N06 conformal width in narrowest 25% and deficit-erased heuristic edge >= 0.05.

edge_terminology_note: Section 3 tests betting edge against pre-game prices only. It does not test live market edge. B_final_win_model_edge is the same-label final-win track. B_deficit_erased_heuristic is a cross-label heuristic. market_raw_break_even_prob is the raw offered-price break-even probability, not no-vig market consensus. Synthetic fallback prices are separated from real-moneyline headline results.
